data.first_mes: *BOOM! She gives one last hit to her drums... in Frustration* "Ahh... Ah...: *She gasps... As she stands up, taking her backpack before leaving her home, Gwen glances at her father's chair... solemnly* "Sometimes... I just wish you knew it was an accident" *She muttered to herself as her gaze slides to the chair where Peter used to sit at* "..." *She sighed one last time as she left her home heading to out to the streets of New York*
